171: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਆ. ਮਨੁ ਠਾਢੇ ॥੧॥
Now by great fortune I have found the perfect Guru; he gave me the teaching of God's Name, and my mind grew calm. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਹਮ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾਂਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Ram, I am called the slave of the true Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਮਰੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਾਗੁ ਦਗਾਨਾ; ਹਮ ਕਰਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਢੇ ॥
The mark of slavery is branded on my brow, for a great debt to the Guru has piled up on me.
ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ. ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ; ਭਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਢੇ ॥੨॥
He has shown me great kindness and done me good, carrying me across the world-ocean so hard to cross. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਤਿਨ ਕੂਰੇ ਗਾਢਨ ਗਾਢੇ ॥
Those with no love for God in their hearts only make false patchwork ties.
ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ; ਤਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਰਭਿ ਗਲਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
As paper rots away in water, so those who follow their own minds rot away in the round of births. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਆਗੈ; ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਠਾਢੇ ॥
We have managed no cleverness till now, nor can we hereafter; as God keeps us, so we stay.
ਹਮ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਤਰੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੧॥੫੯॥
O servant Nanak, pray: O Guru, overlook our faults and show mercy; we are called the dogs at your door. ॥4॥7॥21॥59॥
ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
This body-town is filled with lust and anger; meeting the Guru, every trace of them is destroyed.
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
One whose lot was written by past deeds finds the Guru, and his mind is adorned with light through attention fixed on God. ॥1॥
ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ; ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Join your palms in greeting before the Guru; this is a great good deed.
ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ; ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Bow down flat before the Guru; this is a very good act. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਕਤ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Those cut off from God do not know the taste of God's relish; the thorn of pride stays within them.
ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ. ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਜਮਕਾਲੁ. ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
The further they walk, the more it pricks and they suffer; on their heads they bear the blow of spiritual death. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ; ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
God's devotees stay absorbed in His Name; their pain of birth and death and of the world-ocean is destroyed.
ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
They find the imperishable, all-pervading Supreme Lord, and are greatly honoured in all the realms of creation. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
O God, we are Your poor and humble ones; You are our greatest support, Lord: protect us.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੨॥੬੦॥
O servant Nanak, one who makes the Name the support and prop of his life knows joy in the Name alone. ॥4॥8॥22॥60॥
ਇਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ; ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ. ਧੀਠਾ ॥
In this body-fortress dwells God the King, yet one hardened in vices finds no taste of Him.
ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ. ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
One on whom God, kind to the meek, showed grace has tasted it through the Guru's word and seen. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ. ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ; ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Praise God with your attention on the Guru; this relish is sweet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
God, the Supreme Lord, is beyond reach and beyond the senses; He is found by meeting the Guru and clinging to him as advocate.
ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ; ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਪਰੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
Those whose hearts love the Guru's words: before them the Guru brings the nectar of the Name and serves it. ॥2॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਅਰਾ. ਅਤਿ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੀਠਾ ॥
The heart of one who follows his own mind is very hard; within such people is blackness upon blackness.
ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ. ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ; ਬਿਖੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਫੋਲਿ ਫੁਲੀਠਾ ॥੩॥
Feed a snake as much milk as you like, yet search inside and only poison comes out. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ; ਘਸਿ ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਠਾ ॥
O Lord God, bring me to the holy Guru, that I keep his word in my mouth like the herb chewed to draw out snake poison.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ; ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਕਰੂਆ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੩॥੬੧॥
O servant Nanak, say: we are the Guru's slaves and servants; in his company the bitter nature turns sweet. ॥4॥9॥23॥61॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ. ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਬੇਚਿਆ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੇ ॥
For the sake of meeting God, I have sold my body to the perfect Guru.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ; ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
The true Guru, the giver, has fixed the Name in me; fortune has woken on my face and brow, and I am blessed. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only by walking by the Guru's counsel does love for Ram, the Lord, take hold. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
172: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Though beautiful Ram pervades every body, love for Him takes hold only through the Guru's word.
ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ; ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ. ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
I am ready to give my mind and body to the Guru, to cut off my head and give it; through the Guru's words my wandering and fear depart. ॥2॥
ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ. ਦੀਪਕ ਆਨਿ ਜਲਾਏ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ. ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Into the darkness the Guru brings a lamp and lights it; through the Guru's knowledge love for God takes hold,
ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ; ਘਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੀ. ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
the darkness of ignorance is wholly destroyed, the treasure of the Name is found in the heart's home, and the mind awakes. ॥3॥
ਸਾਕਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ; ਤਿਨ. ਜਮ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Those who make Maya their life's support are cut off from God and grow cruel; spiritual death keeps them in its sight.
ਉਨ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ, ਸੀਸੁ ਨ ਬੇਚਿਆ; ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥
They do not sell their heads to the true Guru; the unfortunate ones keep coming and going. ॥4॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗੇ ॥
Hear my prayer, O God, my Master: I have come to Your refuge and beg for Your Name.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ. ਲਜ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ; ਸਿਰੁ ਬੇਚਿਓ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੪॥੬੨॥
The Guru alone keeps servant Nanak's honour; I have sold my head to the true Guru. ॥5॥10॥24॥62॥
ਹਮ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ. ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Without the Guru we stay proud, our understanding full of pride and ignorance; when the Guru is met, the self is lost.
ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
When the disease of pride goes, joy comes; all this is the grace of the Guru, the Guru alone. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching one meets Ram, the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
Love for God the King has arisen in my heart; the Guru showed me the road and the way.
ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
I have laid my soul, my body and all before the true Guru, who joined me, long parted, to God's embrace. ॥2॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
A longing to see God arose within me; the Guru showed Him to me dwelling in my heart, beside me.
ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਰੈ; ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
The joy of stillness of mind has come into my mind; in return I have sold myself to the Guru. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ; ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
I committed many sins and offences, did wrong and hid it as thieves hide their theft.
ਅਬ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੫॥੬੩॥
But now, O Nanak, say: Lord, I have come to Your refuge; if it pleases You, keep my honour. ॥4॥11॥25॥63॥
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਜੈ. ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Walking by the Guru's counsel, his word keeps an unbroken hold on the heart; by the Guru's teaching the mind sings God's praise.
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Some person of great fortune receives the Guru's sight; I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who instils love for God. ॥1॥
Only by facing the Guru does one form a love for God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਮਨੁ. ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
The perfect Guru is my Master; my mind does the work the Guru gives.
ਹਮ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
I rub and wash the Guru's feet, for he tells me the talk of God's praise. ॥2॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ; ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Those in whose heart, by the Guru's teaching, the Name, home of all relishes, dwells, and whose tongue sings God's virtues,
ਮਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਨੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
their minds stay sated with joy in the relish of the Name; the hunger for Maya never touches them again. ॥3॥
ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਾਵ. ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ; ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
But no one gains the Name without God's grace, though he try countless ways.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੬॥੬੪॥
O Nanak, in the mind of the servant on whom God shows mercy, He fixes His Name through the Guru's teaching. ॥4॥12॥26॥64॥
O my soul, through the Guru repeat the Name: your fortune has woken.
ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ. ਮਤਿ ਜੀਉ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ. ਰਾਮਾ ॥
Make the Guru's counsel your mother and your life's support, and repeat Ram's Name with your mouth.
ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
Make contentment your father, and take refuge in the Guru, the form of the unborn Lord.
173: O soul, meet Ram: your fortune has turned good. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
I have met the Guru, the yogi who is the form of God; by his grace I enjoy the joy of the spirit.
ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ; ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Guru is ever dyed in the colour of God's Name, and ever free of craving.
O fortunate one, meet that wise Guru of beautiful life.
ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥੨॥
My mind and body are soaked in the colour of God's love. ॥2॥
Come, O saints, let us meet and repeat God's Name together.
ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
In the company of the holy, ever earn the profit of the Name.
ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੰਤਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Let us serve the Gurmukhs and put the life-giving food of the Name in our mouths.
O soul, meet God: the writ of His grace from His court in times past has woken. ॥3॥
ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਰਸੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
As in the month of Savan the cloud rains and fills the earth with water,
ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰੁ. ਕੁਹੁਕਿਅੜਾ; ਸਬਦੁ. ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
and the peacock sings sweetly, so the Guru moves the world with nectar; the fortunate one's mind leaps, and he takes the word into his mouth.
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੜਾ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
One in whose heart the nectar of the Name comes to dwell, who meets God the King,
O servant Nanak, is dyed in the love of God. ॥4॥1॥27॥65॥
ਆਉ ਸਖੀ; ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰੀਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Come, friend, let us make God's virtues our charms to win the Lord,
ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ; ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਹ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
and meeting the saints, let us enjoy the bliss of union with Him.
ਗੁਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ; ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Let us light in our minds the lamp of knowledge the Guru gives,
ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ; ਢੁਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
and if God is pleased, let us merge at His feet in gratitude. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Love for God my friend has arisen in my mind and heart.
ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਚੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
I long that the Guru, the go-between, unite me with that friend.
ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਸੰਤਾ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
I would hand my mind over to the Gurmukhs who unite me with my Lord.
I am ever a sacrifice to God. ॥2॥
ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ. ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਮਨਿ ਵਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my dear Gobind, in mercy come and dwell in my mind.
ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ. ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my Gobind, the bride whose heart blossoms on seeing the perfect Guru gains the fruit she wished for in her mind.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my Gobind, the happy bride who receives God's Name has joy and delight in her mind every moment.
ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਨਿਤ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ. ਮਨਿ ਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
O my Gobind, the fortunate brides who have won union with God earn the profit of the Name and ever rejoice in mind. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ. ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
O friend, God Himself creates, Himself cares for all and Himself sets all to their work.
ਇਕਿ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਬਖਸ. ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਇਕਨਾ. ਫਕਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Many use what He bestows and it never runs out; to many He gives only a little.
ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ. ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ; ਇਕਨਾ. ਭਿਖ ਮੰਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Many sit on thrones as kings, ever at ease; many He makes beg from door to door.
ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥੬੬॥
O servant Nanak, say: O my Gobind, Your one command works everywhere; the one You favour remembers Your Name. ॥4॥2॥28॥66॥
ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ. ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ. ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my Gobind, the one You favour stays dyed in the colour of Your Name within his own mind, within his mind.
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਾਲਿ. ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ. ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my Gobind, the joy of the Name is with everyone, yet not all can enjoy it; those who meet the perfect Guru find the unseen Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਸਭ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ. ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my Gobind, those in whom You light up the Name lose all their poverty and pain.
ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
O my Gobind, those who reach the high state of union with God are fortunate and stay absorbed in the Name. ॥1॥
ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ. ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠੜਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my dear Gobind, only a rare one has seen You, the Lord God, with his own eyes.
ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝਹੁ. ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my Gobind, parted from You my mind and heart are deeply sorrowful; without You, Lord, I the bride am withered.
174: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my Gobind, whoever has found my Lord God, my true friend and companion, found Him by meeting the saints.
ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਮੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ. ਰੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
O my Gobind, God, the life of the world, has come and met me too; now my night of life passes in joy. ॥2॥
ਮੈ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ. ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ; ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
O saints, unite me with my friend, the Lord God; a hunger to meet Him has arisen in my mind and heart.
ਹਉ. ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ, ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਲਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
I cannot keep patience without seeing my beloved; the pain of separation from Him rises within me.
ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
God is my King and my dear friend; when the Guru unites me with Him, my mind comes alive.
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
O my Gobind, when You meet me, Lord, the hope of my mind and heart is fulfilled and high spirits rise in my mind. ॥3॥
ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ. ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ. ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my Gobind, O my dear one, I am a sacrifice, ever a sacrifice to You.
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ. ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my Gobind, love for You, my beloved, has woken in my mind and heart; guard this capital of mine.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਮੇਲਿ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ. ਕਰਿ ਰੈਬਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my Gobind, unite me with the Guru, the go-between, who will guide me and unite me with You, Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੭॥
O my Gobind, servant Nanak has come to Your refuge; by Your mercy alone I have received Your Name. ॥4॥3॥29॥67॥
ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ. ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
O my dear one, O my Gobind, You are my Lord God who does as He pleases.
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ. ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ. ਗੋਪੀ ਖੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
God Himself creates Krishna, and God Himself is the milkmaid who seeks him.
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਦਾ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਭੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Pervading all bodies, God Himself enjoys all things; He Himself tastes their relish and Himself enjoys them.
ਹਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ. ਨ ਭੁਲਈ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
But God is all-wise and does not go astray; He Himself is the true Guru, the yogi untouched by pleasures. ॥1॥
ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੇਲੈ. ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
God Himself creates the world, and Himself plays its play in many colours.
ਇਕਨਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ. ਨੰਗ ਨੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
He Himself has many enjoy the pleasures of Maya's things, while many wander about naked.
ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
He Himself creates the world; all people beg from Him, and He gives gifts to all.
ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
His devotees have the Name as their support; they ask God only for His excellent praise. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਲੋਚ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
God Himself has His devotees worship Him, and Himself fulfils the longing in their minds.
ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ. ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
God Himself pervades water and land; He is present in all and far from none.
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
God Himself dwells within all and outside in the whole world; He Himself fills every place.
ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
The all-pervading Ram Himself spreads out this expanse of the world; staying beside each one, He Himself cares for all. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
As the breath of life in all, God Himself is the instrument; as He plays each one, so it sounds.
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
The treasure of the Name is within each one, but only through the Guru's word does the Lord God become manifest.
ਆਪੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
God Himself prompts a person into His refuge, and Himself guards the honour of His devotees.
175: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੮॥
O servant Nanak, you too join the congregation and become greatly fortunate; through the Name life's purpose is fulfilled. ॥4॥4॥30॥68॥
ਮੈ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ; ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord has set within me a longing for his Name,
ਮੇਰਾ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
and I can know joy only when my friend, the Lord God, meets me.
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
O mother, on seeing the Lord God spiritual life arises within me.
ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
The Lord's Name is my friend and my brother. ॥1॥
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ; ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
O saints, sing the praises of my Lord God,
ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ; ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
for great good fortune awakens when the Name is repeated in the Guru's refuge.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord's Name is now the support of my life.
ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ; ਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
One who repeats it is not put through the rounds of the world-ocean again. ॥2॥
ਕਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਖਾ; ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
In my mind and heart there is an eagerness: how may I see the Lord God?
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ; ਮਨਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
O saints, a longing has taken hold of my mind; unite me with the Lord.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Only through the Guru's Word is the beloved Lord, the King, met;
by great good fortune, repeating the Name, he is met. ॥3॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
In my mind and heart there is a great hope of meeting the Lord God.
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ; ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
O saints, unite me with that Lord God who dwells within me.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Only by walking in the true Guru's teaching does the Lord's Name always shine within.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰਿਅੜੀ; ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੧॥੬੯॥
O servant Nanak, the hope that arose in the mind is then fulfilled. ॥4॥5॥31॥69॥
ਮੇਰਾ. ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
I can gain spiritual life only when my parted friend, the Lord's Name, meets me.
ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
The life-giving nectar is within the mind, yet I can take it only through the Guru's teaching.
ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
If my mind is dyed in the colour of the Lord's love, I keep drinking the savour of his Name always.
When the Lord is found, I come alive in my mind. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
The arrow of the Lord's love has pierced my mind and heart.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ; ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
The all-knowing Lord, the Supreme Being, alone is my beloved and my friend.
ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੰਤ; ਹਰਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
It is the Guru who unites one with that saintly, skilful, all-knowing Lord,
and then I offer myself to the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ; ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
O saints, I ask you the whereabouts of the Lord, my companion and friend.
ਹਰਿ ਦਸਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਪਵਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Tell me, O saints; I go about searching for the Lord.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਦਸੇ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
I can meet the Lord only when the true Guru, being pleased, shows the way,
and only then can I stay absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
ਮੈ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
The pain of separation, love for the Lord and a longing to meet him have arisen within me.
ਗੁਰ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Guru, fulfil my yearning, that I may put the nectar of his Name in my mouth.
ਹਰਿ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, be merciful to me, that I may meditate on your Name,
and, O servant Nanak, that I may obtain the savour of your Name. ॥4॥6॥20॥18॥32॥70॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਹੋਤ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
O my brother, by what means can spiritual joy arise?
ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
How can the Lord, the real friend, be met? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕੁਸਲੁ ਨ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
There is no spiritual joy in attachment to the home, nor in thinking that all this Maya is mine,
nor in lofty mansions and the shade of beautiful gardens.
One who looks for it there has wasted his human birth in false greed. ॥1॥
176: A man feels glad at the sight of his elephants and horses,
he gathers armies and keeps ministers and royal servants,
but round his neck falls only the rope, the noose of pride. ॥2॥
As king he rules the whole earth in all ten directions,
revels in pleasures and enjoys many women,
yet all this is like a king who becomes a beggar in a dream and suffers. ॥3॥
ਏਕੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
The true Guru has shown me the one source of real spiritual joy:
ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
whatever the Lord does is sweet to his devotees.
O servant Nanak, having killed pride, such a one stays absorbed in the Lord. ॥4॥
ਇਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਹੋਤ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
In this way, O my brother, spiritual joy arises,
ਇਉ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
and in this way the Lord, the real friend, is met. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥
ਕਿਉ ਭ੍ਰਮੀਐ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
The mind stops wandering, since no wandering after any thing of Maya remains,
ਜਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ; ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
once one is sure that the same Lord pervades water, land and sky.
Those who face the Guru are saved; those who follow their own minds lose their honour. ॥1॥
The one whom the merciful Lord himself protects,
ਤਿਸੁ; ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
no one else can equal him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When you are sure that the one infinite Lord pervades all,
ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਉ; ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
only then can you rest in spiritual joy, free of worry.
ਓਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਜੋ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
He knows everything that takes place. ॥2॥
Those who follow their own minds, gripped by the thirst for Maya, remain spiritually dead;
ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਹਿ; ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
by their past deeds it is written from the first that they wander through many births.
They eat the fruit of whatever seed they sow. ॥3॥
The one whose mind blossoms on seeing the Lord everywhere,
sees God shining in every place.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੧॥
O Nanak, the Lord fulfils the hopes of that servant. ॥4॥2॥71॥
For many births you were a worm or a moth,
for many births an elephant, a fish or a deer.
For many births you became a bird or a snake,
for many births you were yoked as a horse or an ox. ॥1॥
Meet the Lord of the world now; this human birth is the time to meet him.
After a long time you have received this body. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
For many births you were made into stones and rocks,
for many births you were lost from the womb before birth.
For many births you were brought forth as a tree,
and so you were driven through the eighty-four hundred thousand forms of life. ॥2॥
Now you have obtained a human birth; come into the company of the holy,
ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ; ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ॥
take the Guru's teaching, serve, and worship the Lord.
Give up vanity, falsehood and arrogance.
You are accepted in the Lord's court only if you die to self while still living. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ; ਸੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
O Lord, whatever happens comes about from you;
no one else has the power to do anything.
You are met only when you yourself unite a being with you,
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੨॥
O Nanak, and only then can he sing the Lord's praises. ॥4॥3॥72॥
In the field of deeds, this human body, sow the Lord's Name;
so the purpose of your life will be accomplished.
You will reap this fruit, that your fear of spiritual death goes,
ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸ ॥੧॥
if you sing the Lord's virtues and praise every day. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Keep the Lord's Name treasured within your heart,
and so set right the purpose of your human life without delay. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Stay alert in the remembrance of your God;
then you will receive honour in his presence.
177: Give up all your arguments and cleverness,
and take refuge with those who follow the Guru. ॥2॥
ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਹਹਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
The Lord in whose hand all beings are,
ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ; ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
who is never parted from them and is with them all,
ਉਪਾਵ ਛੋਡਿ; ਗਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
drop your own efforts and hold to his support,
and in the blink of an eye you will be set free. ॥3॥
ਸਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Know him to be always near you.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ; ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Accept with conviction that God's will is unshakeable.
Joined to the Guru's word, wipe out your sense of self.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੩॥
O Nanak, keep repeating the Lord's Name, keep reciting his virtues. ॥4॥4॥73॥
The Guru's teaching never wears out or grows old.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
Through the Guru's word the noose of attachment, which brings spiritual death, is cut.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
The Guru's teaching stays with the soul always.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਰਚੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
Through the Guru's word a person stays joined to the colour of the Lord's love. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ; ਸੁ. ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
What the Guru has given is of use to the mind;
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ; ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
know that what the Guru has done will stay with you for ever. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Guru's teaching is unfailing and never wears away.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਕਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੇਦ ॥
Through the Guru's word a person's wandering and his sense of division are cut away.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The Guru's teaching never goes to waste.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
Through the Guru's word a person keeps singing the Lord's praises. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
The Guru's teaching keeps company with the soul.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
The Guru's teaching becomes the support of souls that have none.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ॥
Through the Guru's word a person does not fall into hell,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਵੈ ॥੩॥
and through the Guru's word his tongue relishes the life-giving savour of the Name. ॥3॥
The Guru's teaching makes a person known in the world.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Through the Guru's word he does not come away having lost the game of life.
The person to whom God himself is gracious,
O Nanak, to him the true Guru is always merciful. ॥4॥5॥74॥
He who made this precious human body out of clay,
ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
who with care protected me in the womb,
who gave me honour and greatness,
ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
that God I remember through all eight watches of the day. ॥1॥
O beautiful Lord, may I obtain the dust of the feet of those who follow the Guru,
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and, meeting the Guru, keep remembering you, my Master. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He who made me, a fool, into a fine speaker,
who made me, the senseless, into one who understands,
by whose grace I receive all nine treasures,
ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਮਨ ਤੇ. ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
that God is not forgotten by my mind. ॥2॥
He who gave a place to me who had none,
who gave honour to me who had none,
who has fulfilled my every hope,
him I remember day and night, with every breath and every morsel. ॥3॥
By his grace the noose of Maya has been cut from me,
and by the Guru's grace Maya, once sweet as nectar, now seems bitter poison to me.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Says Nanak: nothing lies in this creature's own power;
I praise the Lord who protects. ॥4॥6॥75॥
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
In his refuge no fear can touch and no worry can take hold,
ਉਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
for nothing can be outside his control.
So I have given up the vice of relying on my own cleverness, strength and intellect;
he is able to protect the honour of his servant. ॥1॥
ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
O my mind, repeat the Lord's Name with love;
ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in the heart and outside it, that Name is always with you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ; ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Keep his support in your mind,
178: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
and taste the Guru's Word, the life-giving savour.
Tell me, what use are any other efforts?
In his mercy the Lord himself protects one's honour. ॥2॥
Tell me, what can human beings do, and what does their swagger amount to?
All the bluster of Maya is false.
The Master himself does everything and causes beings to do everything;
he knows the heart of every being. ॥3॥
This is the highest of all joys, and the one that lasts:
keep the Guru's teaching settled in your mind.
ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
The one whose devotion is fixed on the Lord's Name,
Says Nanak: he is blessed and greatly fortunate. ॥4॥7॥76॥
Those who washed off the filth of their minds by hearing the Lord's praise,
became wholly pure and gained countless joys.
By great good fortune they gained union with the Guru,
and love for the Supreme Lord took hold in them. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਜਨੁ ਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
The servant who repeats the Lord's Name has been carried across;
ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Guru has taken him over the ocean of fire, of craving. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those whose minds were cooled by singing the Lord's praise,
had the sins of birth after birth removed.
They saw every treasure within their own minds,
so why would they now go anywhere else to search? ॥2॥
When God becomes merciful to his own servants,
their labour of service bears fruit.
Cutting their bonds, he makes them his own servants,
and remembering, ever remembering the Lord, the treasury of virtues, they merge in him. ॥3॥
He sees the One alone in his heart and the One alone in every place,
he sees the Lord filling everywhere completely,
the one whose every wandering of mind the perfect Guru has removed;
O Nanak, remembering the Lord he has found spiritual joy. ॥4॥8॥77॥
The forebears who have died are forgotten,
ਜੋ ਉਬਰੇ; ਸੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਕੁ ਖਰੇ ॥
and those still living gird their loins to gather wealth.
The business in which those elders were entangled,
ਉਨ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣ; ਦਿੜੀ ਉਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
the living grip that Maya twice as hard as they did. ॥1॥
ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ; ਕਛੁ. ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
That hour does not come to mind at all, when everything must be left behind;
a man clings to the very thing that will perish. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The fool's body is bound fast by hopes;
he stays caught in lust, anger and attachment.
yet the fool keeps eating the poison of Maya, thinking it sweet. ॥2॥
He says: I will bind him, I will have my revenge on him;
who dares set foot on my land?
I am learned, I am clever and wise.
The fool does not even recognise the Lord who made him. ॥3॥
The Lord alone knows what he is like and how great he is;
ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ; ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
a creature can say nothing of it, can describe nothing.
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
O Lord, to whatever you attach a being, to that alone it can attach itself.
Everyone has to ask you for his own good. ॥4॥
All this is of your making; you are the maker of the whole world.
Your virtues have no end, and no near or far shore of you can be found.
O Lord, grant your servant this gift,
that Nanak may never forget your Name. ॥5॥9॥78॥
No amount of effort brings release from suffering;
much cleverness only loads a heavier burden on the head.
If one serves the Lord with pure love,
one reaches God's court with honour. ॥1॥
179: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਓਲਾ ॥
O my mind, hold to the shelter of the Lord's Name,
ਤੁਝੈ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਾਤਾ ਝੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and no gust of hot wind will touch you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As a ship saves one in the fearful ocean,
as lamps give light in the darkness,
as fire takes away the misery of cold,
so joy arises in the mind when the Name is remembered. ॥2॥
ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਇ; ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
The thirst of your mind will fall away,
every hope of yours will be fulfilled,
and your mind will not waver.
So, my friend, in the Guru's refuge repeat the life-giving Name. ॥3॥
That person alone receives the medicine of the Name,
to whom the Lord, in his mercy, causes it to be given through the Guru.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥
The one in whose heart the Lord's Name comes to dwell,
O Nanak, all his pain and suffering flee. ॥4॥10॥79॥
ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਕਰਿ; ਮਨੁ ਨ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
The mind is not filled even by piling up great wealth.
It is not satisfied even by gazing on countless beauties.
A man stays entangled, thinking: this is my wife, this is my son.
That beauty perishes, and they turn to a heap of ashes. ॥1॥
I see beings wailing without worship of the Lord.
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ. ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧਨੁ; ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Cursed is the body and cursed the wealth of those who are drunk on Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਉ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ; ਦੀਜਹਿ ਦਾਮ ॥
As when money is loaded on the head of a forced labourer,
ਓਇ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਉਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮ ॥
the money reaches the owner's house and the labourer has borne only the pain,
as a man in a dream sits enthroned as king,
and when he opens his eyes it all comes to nothing, ॥2॥
as a watchman guards another's field,
ਖੇਤੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਰਾਖਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
the crop belongs to the owner and the watchman gets up and leaves;
the watchman wears himself out for the sake of that field,
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪੜੈ ॥੩॥
yet nothing comes into his hands. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਜੁ; ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥
The one who gives the kingdom also gives the dream;
ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀਨੀ; ਤਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
he who gave Maya has himself attached the craving for it.
He himself brings spiritual death, and he himself makes life's purpose succeed.
O Nanak, pray at God's door alone. ॥4॥11॥80॥
ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੇਖੀ ॥
I have seen many-coloured Maya enticing in many ways.
With pen and paper many have written works of learning,
many have tried being headmen, kings and lords,
but by these no one's mind has been satisfied. ॥1॥
ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
O saints, tell me of that joy,
by which craving is quenched; make my mind content. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Riding on elephants and horses swift as the wind,
perfume and sandalwood, the bed of a beautiful woman,
actors' plays in the arena and their songs:
ਤਾ ਮਹਿ; ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
in these no mind has found contentment. ॥2॥
A throne, the splendour of a royal court, carpets,
fruits of every kind, lovely gardens,
a taste for the hunt, the sports of kings:
the mind is not made happy by them; all this effort proves a deception. ॥3॥
In their kindness the saints told me the truth,
that this joy, the root of all comforts, is found
when the Lord's praises are sung in the company of the holy.
Says Nanak: it is obtained by great good fortune. ॥4॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
He alone is at ease who has the wealth of the Lord's Name;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥੮੧॥
sitting in the company of the holy comes only by God's grace. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥12॥81॥
180: Caught in Maya, a person thinks this body is his own for ever.
Again and again he clings to this very body.
As long as the noose of children, wife and household hangs round the neck,
ਹੋਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
one cannot become a servant of God. ॥1॥
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
What is the way by which a person may sing God's praises?
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
What is the teaching by which one may cross beyond this Maya? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The deed that is for his good, he takes to be bad.
If anyone tells him the truth, it seems like poison to him.
He does not understand which deed wins the game of life and which loses it.
Such is the conduct of a world wrapped in Maya. ॥2॥
What is poison, the man gripped by Maya drinks gladly.
The Name of God gives spiritual life, yet he reckons it bitter.
He does not go near the company of the holy,
and so he wanders round the cycle of eighty-four lakh births. ॥3॥
The birds, the souls, are all snared in the one net of Maya.
ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ; ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
With relish they go on enjoying pleasures of many kinds.
Says Nanak: the one to whom God shows mercy,
the perfect Guru cuts away that person's snares. ॥4॥13॥82॥
By Your grace, Lord, the right path of life is found.
By God's grace the Name is remembered.
By God's grace the net of Maya's bonds breaks.
By Your grace, Lord, our pride goes. ॥1॥
Only if You Yourself set us to Your service can we take to it.
ਹਮ ਤੇ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By our own effort, O radiant Lord, we can do nothing at all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If it pleases You, then I can sing the hymns of Your praise.
If it pleases You, then I can utter Your ever-abiding Name.
If it pleases You, then the Guru's grace comes upon us.
Every comfort, Lord, lies in Your kindness. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
The deed that pleases You is the pure deed.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
The way of life that pleases You is the unshakeable way.
ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ; ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
All treasures and all virtues are in Your keeping alone.
You are my Master, and to You alone Your servant prays. ॥3॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Staying in God's love, the mind and body become pure.
Staying in the company of the holy, I find every comfort.
The one whose mind stays dyed in Your Name,
O Nanak, knows this alone to be the highest bliss. ॥4॥14॥83॥
O my tongue, all the other tastes that you keep tasting
do not quench your thirst even for the blink of an eye.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕਾ; ਤੂੰ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
If you were to taste the savour of God's Name,
at the very tasting you would be lost in it. ॥1॥
O my dear tongue, drink the life-giving nectar of the Name.
ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The tongue steeped in this taste is content and wants no other. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹੇ ਜਿਹਵੇ; ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
O my tongue, sing the praises of God.
ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
Moment by moment, at all times, remember God's Name.
One should hear nothing but God's praise and go nowhere but to the company of the holy.
Yet the company of the holy is found only by great good fortune. ॥2॥
O my tongue, through all eight watches remember
the unfathomable Master, the supreme God.
Life is then for ever at ease, here and hereafter.
Singing God's praises, the tongue becomes most precious. ॥3॥
All the plants are in bloom and the trees bear flower and fruit,
ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਛੋਡੇ ॥
yet one whose tongue is steeped in the taste of the Name never gives it up.
ਆਨ ਨ ਰਸ ਕਸ; ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
No other tastes of any kind can equal the Name,
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੪॥
Says Nanak: in the eyes of one whose helper the Guru becomes. ॥4॥15॥84॥
God has made the mind His fine house, and the body the fence that guards it.
